Patch on top of [v0.3.0](https://github.com/archstats/archstats/releases/tag/v0.3.0).

**Git repository discovery was broken on Windows.** The repository's path was built with `filepath.Join` and then trimmed by hand through a helper that asks whether the path contains `/` — which a Windows path never does. Every repository in a workspace was reported as the root, so they all collapsed into one and per-repository git metrics were wrong.

Paths are now made with `filepath.Rel` and converted with `ToSlash`
